entities.name: Piedro
entities.description: A beggar-turned-renegade corrupted by Anna's stolen sword who later reforms and marries Issabela.

entities.name: Madhobi
entities.description: Takes in Issabela and Anthony, introducing them to The Hidden Ones.
entities.quote: They are taken in by Madhobi, who introduces them to The Hidden Ones — Zaan’s surviving spiritual order.

updates.new_facts: Demoted from leadership of the Nullborn, spared Piedro, married him, and retired from fighting to hide and guard Anna's sacred sword.
updates.quote: Issabela finally retires, letting go of the blade, the mask, and the shadows.

updates.new_facts: Former elite who served under Anna; saved Issabela and rebuilt the Nullborn under Anna's strict ideology after executing its puppet leader.
updates.quote: Anthony — a former elite who once served under Anna.

updates.new_facts: Infiltrated and controlled by the Borgia before being rebuilt by Anthony as a ruthless organization operating under Anna's cold ideology.
updates.quote: With loyal survivors and Anna’s disciples, he rebuilds the Nullborn — not with mercy, but with Anna’s cold ideology

updates.new_facts: Zaan's surviving spiritual order who took in Issabela and Anthony.
updates.quote: The Hidden Ones — Zaan’s surviving spiritual order.

timeline_events.title: Demotion of Issabela
timeline_events.description: Issabela is stripped of her leadership of the Nullborn following the Khalid tragedy.
timeline_events.quote: After the Khalid tragedy, Issabela is demoted as leader of the Nullborn.

timeline_events.title: Rebuilding of the Nullborn
timeline_events.description: Anthony assassinates the Borgia puppet leader and rebuilds the Nullborn into a relentless force following Anna's uncompromising doctrine.
timeline_events.quote: The Nullborn in modern times — feared, relentless, emotionless — are born not from evil, but from righteous vengeance turned rigid law.
